rl.title: Return label or link
rl.what: The carrier label of the goods coming back: made now from the shipment they went out on (the addresses swapped), or a link the customer uses to book the carrier only when the goods go.
rl.offline: No connection: nothing is booked or sent until the network is back.
rl.from: A new label swaps the addresses of shipment {shipment}.

empty.title: Nothing booked
empty.body: Make a return label: one booked now, or a link the customer uses within {days} days.

passOn.copied: Link copied: pass it on to the customer. It is shown this once.
passOn.shown: The link to pass on, shown this once:

done.booked: The return label is booked: open its PDF to print it or send it.
done.offered_one: The link went to {count} contact of the customer.
done.offered_other: The link went to {count} contacts of the customer.

failed.read: The return labels could not be read.
failed.forbidden: You may not make or withdraw return labels for this return.
failed.refused: The return label was refused as it is: read the return again.
failed.offline: The factory could not be reached: nothing was booked.
failed.error: Something went wrong: nothing was booked.

held.right: Making return labels needs the right to manage returns.
held.offline: No connection: try again when the network is back.
held.busy: One moment: the last action is still on its way.
held.final: A used or withdrawn label never changes.

code.RETURN_CLOSED: A return label is made only while the goods may come back: the return authorised, or received in part.
code.NO_SHIPMENT: No shipment of the return's order left us: the label swaps the addresses of the shipment the goods went out on.
code.TEST_MODE: The return's site is in test mode (Shipping settings): a TEST label would reach the customer, who never gets one.
code.NO_CARRIER_ACCOUNT: The company has no usable Sendcloud connection: nothing can be booked.
code.NO_ADDRESS: The site has no return or sender address in its shipping settings, or the shipment's address is incomplete.
code.NO_SERVICE: Neither the shipment nor the site names a carrier and a service to book.
code.NO_RECIPIENT: The customer has no active orders contact with an e-mail address: pass the link on instead.
code.FINAL: This return label is used or withdrawn: it never changes.
code.NOT_OFFERED: This label was booked or withdrawn already.
code.CARRIER: The carrier did not book the label: try again in a moment.

dialog.title: Make a return label for {number}
dialog.label: Book the label now
dialog.labelLine: The carrier is booked at once; you print the PDF or send it to the customer.
dialog.linkLine: The customer books the carrier only when the goods go; nothing is booked before. The link opens for {days} days.
dialog.shipment: Shipment the goods went out on
dialog.shipmentHint: Its addresses are swapped: from the customer back to us.
dialog.sendMail: Mail it to the customer's orders contacts
dialog.sendPass: Copy a link to pass on
dialog.sendPassLine: Its address is shown once, here, and copied to the clipboard.
dialog.labelNote: Booking a label may cost money at the carrier.
dialog.linkNote: The link mail is in the customer's language; nothing goes to the carrier until the customer books.

cancelDialog.title: Withdraw this return label?
cancelDialog.offered: Its link stops opening at once; nothing was booked.
cancelDialog.booked: The label {reference} is withdrawn here. The carrier's booking stays in Sendcloud: cancel it there if the customer will not use it.

win.title: Return label of {number}
win.cancelled: This label was withdrawn: do not send it to the customer.

noPdf.title: No PDF yet
noPdf.offered: The label is offered by a link: its PDF exists once the customer books the carrier.
noPdf.cancelled: The label was withdrawn before it was booked: it has no PDF.

problem.notFound: This return label does not exist, or the address is incomplete.
problem.forbidden: You may not see this return.
problem.failed: The return label could not be read.
problem.pdf: The label PDF could not be read.

dv.title: Delivered (from carrier)
dv.what: When each shipment arrived, how we know, and its proof of delivery for a dispute. Once every shipment arrived the order is delivered and the payment steps that run from delivery fall due.
dv.failed: The deliveries could not be read.
dv.waiting: The order is delivered once every shipment that left arrived.
dv.stepsDue: Payment steps that run from delivery: {steps}.
dv.stepsSettled: The payment steps that run from delivery are settled.
dv.noSteps: No payment step runs from delivery.

empty.title: Nothing shipped yet
empty.body: Each shipment shows here once it leaves.

dv.downloadFailed: The proof could not be downloaded: try again.

held.noImage: The carrier gave no image of the proof yet.
held.right: Downloading the proof needs the right to see shipments.
held.offline: No connection: try again when the network is back.
held.busy: One moment: a download is on its way.

link.title: Your return {number}
link.offline: No connection: try again when the network is back.
link.bookHint: When the goods are packed, book the carrier: nothing is booked before you press.
link.printHint: Download the label, print it and stick it on the parcel.

used.title: Your return reached us
used.body: We received it on {at}. We will tell you what happens next.

held.RETURN_CLOSED: This return no longer takes goods back: write to us.
held.NO_SHIPMENT: We cannot book the carrier for this return from here: write to us.
held.TEST_MODE: We cannot book the carrier from here right now: write to us.
held.NO_CARRIER_ACCOUNT: We cannot book the carrier from here right now: write to us.
held.NO_ADDRESS: We cannot book the carrier from here right now: write to us.
held.NO_SERVICE: We cannot book the carrier from here right now: write to us.
held.NO_RECIPIENT: We cannot book the carrier from here right now: write to us.
held.FINAL: This label is used or withdrawn.
held.NOT_OFFERED: This label was booked already: download it below.
held.CARRIER: The carrier did not book the label: try again in a moment.
held.busy: One moment: the last press is still on its way.
held.notBooked: Book the carrier first: the label exists once it is booked.
held.offline: No connection: try again when the network is back.

problem.read: Your return could not be opened.
